summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned domestic Transfer Receipt screen. Passcode 1234 login → Pay & Transfer → James Corbett / 60-83-71 / 12345678 / £120.00 / ref 'Rent June' → Review → Confirm & Send → Receipt renders successfully. All 20 content checks (title, subtitle, all 6 payment-card rows including 'Completed' green pill, all 4 Transaction-details rows with 'Faster Payment', Confirmation banner with title + body, £120.00, James Corbett, and user-typed 'Rent June' in Reference) PASSED. All 4 quick-action buttons (rc-save, rc-email, rc-share, rc-home) are present with correct testIDs. Tapping 'Back to home' correctly navigated to /home. Regression: full transfer flow (form → review → 3-second Processing spinner → receipt) works end-to-end without freeze. TRN/FPID/Reference all populate correctly.

issues: Minor: On the 'To' row the sort code shows the formatted value '60-83-71' followed by the account number with two spaces separator — visually clear but the reference photo tends to put them on separate lines. Cosmetic only.

action_items: No fixes required — redesign matches the spec.
Optional polish: the sort code + account number sub-line on the 'To' row could be split into two lines to match the HSBC UK photo more closely.
critical_code_review_comments: Unused legacy styles remain in StyleSheet (receiptSuccess, receiptSuccessCircle, receiptSuccessText, receiptAmount, receiptCard, receiptCardHeader, receiptCardTitle, receiptDivider, receiptRow, receiptLabel, receiptValue, receiptValueBold, receiptStatusBadge, receiptStatusText, receiptFooter, receiptFooterText, receiptDoneBtn, receiptDoneBtnText, receiptAnotherBtn, receiptAnotherBtnText, receiptScroll). Recommend removing to reduce file size (currently 1416 lines, above the 700-line guideline). Not blocking.
transfers.tsx is 1416 lines — consider splitting Review screen and Receipt screen into separate components.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transfer receipt redesign verified against the HSBC UK photo. All testIDs (rc-save, rc-email, rc-share, rc-home) work; rc-home navigates to /(tabs)/home. Passcode is any 4-digit code. Sort code 608371 → Starling Bank in the bank-lookup UI which is expected offline-adapter behavior.
